description: We are a team of university students and young developers passionate about AI , Machine Learning, Data Science, and Space Technology. For NASA Space Challenge,  we aim to use NASA open datas to build an innovative solution with full interactivity to  a real world problem . summary: Emberly harmonizes NASA MODIS and VIIRS fire data into one burning-activity calendar with ML wildfire prediction, supporting early warning and emergency response worldwide.
details:
Emberly is a wildfire detection and early warning platform that unifies satellite records into one picture of burning activity. Each detection's Fire Radiative Power is divided by its actual pixel footprint (scan × track, present in both FIRMS products), giving FRP density in MW/km². This makes intensity comparable across sensors of different resolution.Random Forest Regression model is trained on historical detection density per 0.5° grid cell plus day-of-year seasonality. When multiple years of data are available, the model trains only on past years and is validated against the most recent year data it never saw during training , reported as a correlation coefficient, mean absolute error, and a predicted-vs-actual plot. 

It harmonizes sensor data, clusters detections, and uses a machine learning model to predict fire risk. A dashboard helps emergency responders, scientists, and land managers anticipate critical periods and respond earlier
